name: Autosomal Recessive Diffuse Palmoplantar Keratoderma

criteria.description: Presence of diffuse thickening and hyperkeratosis of the palms and soles
Confirmed autosomal recessive inheritance pattern by family history or genetic testing
Skin biopsy showing hyperkeratosis with absence of epidermolytic changes
Exclusion of associated systemic abnormalities or syndromic features

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Diffuse palmoplantar keratoderma with autosomal recessive inheritance confirmed by family history or genetic testing and supportive histopathology
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may identify causative mutations in keratin or related genes.
